svg.title: How Claude Code resolves a skill name
svg.desc: Two entry points, typing slash name or Claude matching a skill description, feed one lookup order: project .claude/, then user ~/.claude/, then plugins, then built-in. First match wins. Both .claude/commands/name.md and .claude/skills/name/SKILL.md create the same slash name command.
